name: magnet-menu
title: Magnet Menu
description: A navigation menu whose hover highlight slides from link to link, and an underline that marks the current page, both placed with CSS anchor positioning.
label: Anchor magnet menu
author: Jhey <https://codepen.io/jh3y>

loop.script: hover[1] → hover[3] → hover[2] → hover[5] → hover[4] → idle

props.name: orientation
props.description: Lay the links out in a row or a column (the pen's orientation button).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name of the navigation landmark. Give it one whenever the page has more than one navigation landmark (axe's landmark-unique); upstream's nav had none.

props.name: MagnetMenuLink active
props.description: The current page: underlined and announced with aria-current="page". A link the URL hash targets is underlined too.

props.name: MagnetMenuLink
props.description: Every anchor prop (href, target, rel, onClick, id).

props.name: --magnet-menu-ink / --magnet-menu-paper
props.description: The text color and the page color the labels, pill and underline are mixed from. The items set black on white and white on black for the light and dark themes.

props.name: --magnet-menu-indicator
props.description: Overrides the pill's color (default: 15% ink over paper, as upstream).

a11y: A navigation landmark of links (name it with aria-label when the page has another): Tab moves through them, and the pill follows keyboard focus as it follows the pointer. The current page carries aria-current="page".

The label color is upstream's 50% mix of ink over paper (about 4.5:1 on white). Under prefers-contrast: more it is raised to 75%; under forced colors the links use LinkText and the pill is drawn as a Highlight outline.
Reduced motion: the pill and underline move and fade at once.
Right to left: the pill and underline are anchored to the links, so they follow the mirrored order.
